parameters.query:
with requested as (
    select
        $1::uuid as transaction_id,
        $2::text as business_id,
        $3::jsonb as workflow_input
),
current_data as (
    select t.*
    from commerce.transactions t
    inner join requested r
        on r.transaction_id = t.id
       and r.business_id = t.business_id
)
select
    r.transaction_id,
    r.business_id,
    r.workflow_input,

    case
        when t.id is not null then true
        else false
    end as transaction_found,

    case
        when t.id is null then null
        else to_jsonb(t)
    end as current_transaction,

    (
        select to_jsonb(p)
        from commerce.payments p
        where p.transaction_id = r.transaction_id
        order by p.created_at desc
        limit 1
    ) as latest_payment

from requested r
left join current_data t
    on t.id = r.transaction_id;

with input_data as (
    select
        $1::uuid as transaction_id,
        $2::text as expected_status,
        $3::numeric as amount,
        $4::char(3) as currency,
        $5::text as shopify_cart_id,
        $6::text as checkout_url,
        $7::timestamptz as expires_at,
        $8::text as idempotency_key,
        $9::jsonb as shopify_payload,
        $10::jsonb as workflow_payload
),

existing_payment as (
    select p.*
    from commerce.payments p
    inner join input_data d
        on p.transaction_id = d.transaction_id
    where
        p.metadata ->> 'idempotency_key' = d.idempotency_key
        or (
            p.provider = 'shopify'
            and p.payment_method = 'shopify_checkout'
            and p.status in ('pending', 'created', 'waiting_confirmation')
        )
    order by p.created_at desc
    limit 1
),

inserted_payment as (
    insert into commerce.payments (
        transaction_id,
        provider,
        provider_payment_id,
        payment_method,
        status,
        amount,
        currency,
        payment_url,
        expires_at,
        metadata,
        created_at,
        updated_at
    )
    select
        d.transaction_id,
        'shopify',
        d.shopify_cart_id,
        'shopify_checkout',
        'pending',
        d.amount,
        d.currency,
        d.checkout_url,
        d.expires_at,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'idempotency_key', d.idempotency_key,
            'shopify_cart_id', d.shopify_cart_id,
            'shopify_checkout_url', d.checkout_url,
            'shopify_payload', d.shopify_payload,
            'created_by', 'DALIA_M5_02_Payment_Management'
        ),
        now(),
        now()
    from input_data d
    where not exists (
        select 1
        from existing_payment
    )
    returning *
),

resolved_payment as (
    select to_jsonb(ep) as payment
    from existing_payment ep

    union all

    select to_jsonb(ip) as payment
    from inserted_payment ip

    limit 1
),

updated_transaction as (
    update commerce.transactions t
    set
        status = 'payment_pending',
        sub_status = 'shopify_checkout_url_sent',
        next_action = 'wait_payment_confirmation',
        metadata =
            coalesce(t.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'last_payment_operation',
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'provider', 'shopify',
                    'payment_method', 'shopify_checkout',
                    'shopify_cart_id', d.shopify_cart_id,
                    'checkout_url', d.checkout_url,
                    'idempotency_key', d.idempotency_key,
                    'processed_at', now()
                )
            ),
        updated_at = now()
    from input_data d
    where
        t.id = d.transaction_id
        and t.status = d.expected_status
    returning t.*
),

inserted_event as (
    insert into commerce.events (
        transaction_id,
        event_type,
        source,
        status,
        payload,
        processed_at
    )
    select
        d.transaction_id,
        'shopify_checkout_created',
        'DALIA_M5_02_Payment_Management',
        'processed',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'provider', 'shopify',
            'shopify_cart_id', d.shopify_cart_id,
            'checkout_url', d.checkout_url,
            'idempotency_key', d.idempotency_key
        ),
        now()
    from input_data d
    where exists (
        select 1
        from updated_transaction
    )
    returning id
)

select
    case
        when exists (
            select 1
            from resolved_payment
        )
        and exists (
            select 1
            from updated_transaction
        )
        then true
        else false
    end as persisted,

    case
        when exists (
            select 1
            from existing_payment
        )
        then true
        else false
    end as duplicate_or_existing,

    (
        select payment
        from resolved_payment
        limit 1
    ) as payment,

    (
        select to_jsonb(t)
        from updated_transaction t
        limit 1
    ) as transaction,

    (
        select id
        from inserted_event
        limit 1
    ) as event_id,

    d.workflow_payload

from input_data d;

with input_data as (
    select
        $1::uuid as transaction_id,
        $2::text as expected_status,
        $3::text as shopify_order_id,
        $4::text as shopify_cart_id,
        $5::text as normalized_status,
        $6::numeric as amount,
        $7::char(3) as currency,
        $8::text as event_idempotency_key,
        $9::jsonb as event_payload,
        $10::jsonb as workflow_payload
),

already_processed as (
    select e.*
    from commerce.events e
    inner join input_data d
        on e.transaction_id = d.transaction_id
    where
        e.event_type = 'shopify_payment_event_processed'
        and e.payload ->> 'event_idempotency_key' = d.event_idempotency_key
    limit 1
),

target_payment as (
    select p.*
    from commerce.payments p
    inner join input_data d
        on p.transaction_id = d.transaction_id
    where
        p.provider = 'shopify'
        and (
            p.provider_payment_id = d.shopify_cart_id
            or p.metadata ->> 'shopify_cart_id' = d.shopify_cart_id
            or p.status in ('pending', 'created', 'waiting_confirmation')
        )
    order by p.created_at desc
    limit 1
),

updated_payment as (
    update commerce.payments p
    set
        status =
            case
                when d.normalized_status = 'confirmed' then 'confirmed'
                when d.normalized_status = 'failed' then 'failed'
                when d.normalized_status = 'expired' then 'expired'
                else p.status
            end,
        provider_payment_id =
            coalesce(d.shopify_order_id, p.provider_payment_id),
        amount =
            coalesce(d.amount, p.amount),
        currency =
            coalesce(d.currency, p.currency),
        metadata =
            coalesce(p.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'shopify_order_id', d.shopify_order_id,
                'shopify_cart_id', d.shopify_cart_id,
                'last_shopify_event', d.event_payload,
                'event_idempotency_key', d.event_idempotency_key
            ),
        updated_at = now()
    from input_data d
    where
        p.id = (
            select id
            from target_payment
            limit 1
        )
        and not exists (
            select 1
            from already_processed
        )
    returning p.*
),

updated_transaction as (
    update commerce.transactions t
    set
        status =
            case
                when d.normalized_status = 'confirmed' then 'payment_confirmed'
                when d.normalized_status = 'expired' then 'expired'
                else t.status
            end,
        sub_status =
            case
                when d.normalized_status = 'confirmed' then 'shopify_payment_confirmed'
                when d.normalized_status = 'failed' then 'shopify_payment_failed'
                when d.normalized_status = 'expired' then 'shopify_checkout_expired'
                else t.sub_status
            end,
        next_action =
            case
                when d.normalized_status = 'confirmed' then 'create_order'
                when d.normalized_status = 'failed' then 'create_payment'
                when d.normalized_status = 'expired' then null
                else t.next_action
            end,
        metadata =
            coalesce(t.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'last_shopify_payment_event',
                d.event_payload
            ),
        updated_at = now()
    from input_data d
    where
        t.id = d.transaction_id
        and t.status = d.expected_status
        and not exists (
            select 1
            from already_processed
        )
    returning t.*
),

inserted_event as (
    insert into commerce.events (
        transaction_id,
        event_type,
        source,
        status,
        payload,
        processed_at
    )
    select
        d.transaction_id,
        'shopify_payment_event_processed',
        'DALIA_M5_02_Payment_Management',
        'processed',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'provider', 'shopify',
            'shopify_order_id', d.shopify_order_id,
            'shopify_cart_id', d.shopify_cart_id,
            'normalized_status', d.normalized_status,
            'event_idempotency_key', d.event_idempotency_key,
            'event_payload', d.event_payload
        ),
        now()
    from input_data d
    where
        not exists (
            select 1
            from already_processed
        )
    returning id
),

resolved_payment as (
    select to_jsonb(up) as payment
    from updated_payment up

    union all

    select to_jsonb(tp) as payment
    from target_payment tp
    where exists (
        select 1
        from already_processed
    )

    limit 1
),

resolved_transaction as (
    select to_jsonb(ut) as transaction
    from updated_transaction ut

    union all

    select to_jsonb(t) as transaction
    from commerce.transactions t
    inner join input_data d
        on t.id = d.transaction_id
    where exists (
        select 1
        from already_processed
    )

    limit 1
)

select
    case
        when exists (
            select 1
            from updated_transaction
        )
        then true
        when exists (
            select 1
            from already_processed
        )
        then true
        else false
    end as persisted_or_duplicate,

    case
        when exists (
            select 1
            from already_processed
        )
        then true
        else false
    end as duplicate,

    (
        select payment
        from resolved_payment
        limit 1
    ) as payment,

    (
        select transaction
        from resolved_transaction
        limit 1
    ) as transaction,

    (
        select id
        from inserted_event
        limit 1
    ) as event_id,

    d.workflow_payload

from input_data d;
